summary_1line: Bhishma and Drona warn Duryodhana to make peace with the Pandavas, lamenting the coming war, while Dhritarashtra asks about Krishna’s private words to Karna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Duryodhana stands silent with brows knit and eyes lowered while Bhishma and Drona exchange grave glances before the assembled kings.
Bhishma and Drona solemnly warn Duryodhana in the royal court as ominous vultures circle above the distant army camps.
Krishna the slayer of Madhu lifts Karna onto his chariot outside the city, preparing to speak with him in private.
